input.title: Unisex Jiu Jitsu – I Came Here to Lie Down. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

I CAME HERE TO LIE DOWN. is the jiu jitsu hoodie for the grappler whose game plan is to end up flat on the mat, worn walking into the gym, between rounds and as a gift from a training partner who has been on top.

I CAME HERE runs across the top in heavy rounded capitals and TO LIE DOWN. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a cartoon grappler in a rumpled white gi and a frayed dark belt lies flat on his back on a blue gym mat, hands folded behind his head, eyes half shut and perfectly content, with a squeeze water bottle beside him and sweat drops flying off.

Navy carries cream and faded red lettering with a cream edge around the mat; Sand gets navy and faded red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this jiu jitsu hoodie warm enough for cold gym floors and walks to class?
Yes. The I Came Here to Lie Down. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cold gym floors, walks to class and cool-down after rolling.

How does the I Came Here to Lie Down. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a jiu jitsu fan?
It is a natural one. Every grappler has ended up flat on the mat and called it a plan, so it lands with training partners, coaches and the family that washes the gi. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the mat scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the I Came Here to Lie Down. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
